title: Looking for a dev buddy — PoE-style itemization meets Vampire Survivors combat
author: sharenz0
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’m a professional software developer focused mainly on backend systems and business software. I’ve recently started exploring game development as a hobby, and I’m looking for someone who wants to help shape and build this project with me.

The game is a 2.5D action RPG combining the itemization, crafting, and character depth of **Path of Exile** with the fast, increasingly chaotic combat of **Vampire Survivors**.

The experience is focused almost entirely on **mapping**:

* Maps are physical items that can be found, traded, and crafted
* Each map contains several timed waves of monster packs
* Later waves become increasingly dense and dangerous
* Map modifiers affect pack size, monster rarity, difficulty, item quantity, and item rarity
* Completing maps rewards players with equipment and crafting materials
* Progression comes from character levels, skills, equipment, and crafting
* There are no temporary power-ups between waves

Between maps, players return to their hideout, which contains a stash, merchant, crafting bench, and map device.

The item system is heavily inspired by PoE: normal, magic, rare, and unique items; item levels; affix tiers and ranges; base-item stats; additive and multiplicative modifiers; genuinely rare high-quality items; and a deep crafting economy.

A substantial browser-based prototype already exists. The next major step is **server-authoritative multiplayer for up to four players**, including co-op maps, visiting other players’ hideouts, secure trading, and cheat-resistant characters and items.

The current stack includes TypeScript, React/Vinext, Phaser, Node.js, Colyseus, PostgreSQL, and Docker.

# Non-goals

This is deliberately **not** intended to have a traditional story or campaign. I don’t want to spend years building quests, dialogue, cinematics, and a large linear world before the core game becomes interesting.

The focus is the repeatable endgame-style loop from the beginning:

**Enter maps → kill increasingly large monster waves → find and craft items → improve your build → craft harder maps → repeat.**

I bring professional experience with backend architecture, databases, APIs, and maintainable production software. At the same time, I’m still learning many game-specific areas.

I’m looking for a genuine dev buddy who finds the concept exciting and wants to make creative and technical decisions together—not someone who simply completes assigned tickets. Interest in combat, multiplayer, pixel art, animation, VFX, UI, or ARPG itemization would be especially valuable.

This is currently a hobby project. Enthusiasm, reliability, and a desire to collaborate matter more than having a perfect résumé.

If you’re interested, send me a message with a little about yourself and which parts of the project you would most enjoy working on. I’d be happy to share the current build and codebase.
